summary.text: Salt sand is a snow-white sand that melts on the tongue with a salty taste, an ordinary Gu material sold as edible salt.

claims.text: A million years ago, in the Olden Antiquity Era, a Western Desert human city under threat sent its city lord’s daughter to marry into a variant human group for peace, escorted by the city lord himself. On the way, they found a dying old man covered in abscesses, and the city lord’s daughter, born in the yin year, yin month and yin day, burst his abscesses with her own mouth to heal him. A white-silver liquid flowed out and landed on the desert, and the old man’s body then vanished, his voice alone entrusting the desert to the city lord, who understood only then that he was a human Gu Immortal. The liquid changed the desert into snow-white salt sand, which the city lord sold as edible salt to revive his city.

The sand particles are all clear as crystal or ice and carry a feeling of coldness in them. Fang Yuan’s time path clone travels to the salt sand desert in Mini Western Desert, a warm place in which this one desert stays cool and refreshing. He puts a little of the snow-white sand in his mouth, and it melts on contact with his saliva and gives off a salty taste. Salt sand is no longer unique to Western Desert and is available in all five regions by his time, and his own sovereign immortal aperture holds some, obtained by annexing a Southern Border Gu Immortal’s immortal aperture. Salt sand is an ordinary Gu material, and annexing the Southern Border immortals also brought Fang Yuan at least five to six immortal material resource points.

Origin.text: A Western Desert desert, transformed by a human Gu Immortal's abscess liquid
